name: Azd
description:
The full Azure DevOps experience — pull requests, pipelines and AI — without ever leaving your JetBrains IDE.

Works with Azure DevOps Service and Azure DevOps Server (2020 / 2022) · 10-day free trial

Stop alt-tabbing to the Azure DevOps web portal every time you need to review a pull request, kick off a pipeline, or fix a YAML typo. AzD brings the Azure DevOps workflow you actually use straight into IntelliJ IDEA, Rider, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand and the rest of the JetBrains family — built on the same patterns as JetBrains' own GitHub and GitLab plugins, so it feels native from the first click.

What developers are saying

"This plugin is the only thing standing between Azure DevOps and my complete mental breakdown." — ★★★★★

"Should be the way native integration was done. This is well worth paying for." — ★★★★★

"I raised the issue on a Friday and had a new working version when I came back on Monday." — ★★★★★

Pull requests, done right

  • Active PR overview — see everything you own or are reviewing in one place
  • Create, approve and reject pull requests without leaving the IDE
  • Full code review with IDE syntax highlighting, navigation and inspections
  • Inline comments and threaded discussions

Pipelines without the YAML pain

  • Run and monitor pipelines from the IDE
  • Drill into test results, logs and stack traces in one click
  • Approve, reject or defer Environment and ManualValidation@1 approvals
  • Autocompletion and schema validation for Azure Pipelines YAML

AI that actually helps the PR loop

Works out of the box — AzD ships with a built-in AI provider so you can use AI features from day one without setup. Prefer your own model? Bring your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic or any supported provider.

  • Auto-generated PR titles that match the diff
  • One-click PR descriptions
  • AI chat reviewer that flags issues before your teammates do
  • Smart commit messages that describe what changed and why

Get started

Connect with an Azure DevOps Personal Access Token and you are in. Solo and team licenses available — start with the 10-day free trial.
